text:
molly (AE): Hey finance team — need quick approval for a high-touch trial discount for AuroraMetrics. They had a failed migration last week and onboarding took 3 extra weeks. Sales proposes a 45% credit on first-month invoice + extending trial by 30 days.
raj (sales-ops): FYI AuroraMetrics is mid-market, $18k ARR expected, ramping to $50k over 6 months. AE says risk of churn if we don't give something.
jena (finance): Can you drop the proposed numbers? need to quantify revenue impact and precedent.
molly (AE): Sure. Proposed: 45% credit on first invoice of ~$4,500 => credit ~$2,025. Extend trial 30 days (no revenue during extension). Net short-term impact ~ $2k, expected to increase net retention.
elliot (revops): Quick calc: if they hit $50k ARR in 6 months, LTV uplift > discount. But we should cap this offer to 1x and add clause: approval revocable if usage doesn't increase.
jena (finance): Also need approval window and who signs exception. For anything >$2k credit we require VP/Head sign-off per policy.
molly (AE): Understood. Requesting exception: credit $2,025 + 30d trial. Total revenue impact = $2,025 immediate, potential delayed by 30d.
raj (sales-ops): I've attached the migration ticket link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ONB-734 (note: link pasted).
dealbot: Approval request logged: #DR-1983. Current status: pending finance approval.
jena (finance): I can approve up to $2k locally; this is slightly over. Two options: reduce credit to $2k flat or escalate to VP. Which do you prefer?
molly (AE): Can we round to $2,000? that'll be easier.
jena (finance): If we do $2,000 credit + 30d extension, I can approve it now. Add a clause: credit applied once onboarding ticket marked resolved and usage >= minimal threshold (10k tokens/day or equivalent).
molly (AE): Sounds good. I'll add clause to contract amendment.
raj (sales-ops): I'll prepare the amendment. Please confirm quick PO path: once amendment signed, we apply credit on next invoice.
ena (typo): (ignore)
jena (finance): Confirmed: apply $2,000 credit to next invoice after signed amendment and ticket resolved. Record this as one-off customer success credit. No recurring discounts.
molly (AE): Thanks! tagging for visibility: @jena (finance) approved, @raj (sales-ops) to prepare doc. :rocket:
dealbot: DR-1983 closed: credit approved by finance (internal note: one-off, thresholded).
